svg.title: Example Platform (fictional) · overview
svg.desc: Example Platform (fictional) map: 6 layers from left to right and 3 cross-cutting bands below.

g.aria-label: Sources: Where does the data come from?
Ingestion: How does data get into the platform?
Storage: Where is it kept, and in what format?
Processing and transformation: What engine cleans, joins and prepares it?
Consumption: How does it reach dashboards, reports and apps?
Artificial intelligence: How are models and agents built on the data?
Source systems. Where the business data is born. Components: Admissions system.
Data intake. Brings data in, in batches or as it changes. Components: Relational database connector, Change capture.
Central store. Keeps all the data in a format other tools can read. Components: Raw data zone, Clean tables in an open format.
Preparation. Cleans and combines the data so it is fit for use. Components: Transformation engine, Declarative pipelines.
Dashboards. Turns the data into the indicators people check. Components: Semantic model, Bed occupancy dashboard.
Agents. Answers questions using the data as context. Components: Data question agent.
Governance and security: Who can see what, and how is it audited?

text.tspan: Who can see what, and how is

g.aria-label: Governance. Decides who sees what, and keeps a trail of every access. Components: Central catalog, Row filters and masking.
Connects to Central store, on request
Connects to Dashboards, on request
Operations and cost: How is it monitored, deployed and paid for?
Operations and cost: Usage monitor.
Receives from Preparation, continuous
Orchestration: Who decides what runs, and when?
Orchestration: Task scheduler.
Connects to Preparation, on request
